snippet.title: Sker The Bleeding Veil | The Horror Game Awards 2026
snippet.description:
Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4119440/Sker_The_Bleeding_Veil/?utm_source=horrorgameawards&utm_medium=yt&utm_campaign=announcement

Developed by Stormind Games (The Remothered Trilogy) and Wales Interactive (Maid of Sker, Sker Ritual, Dead Reset)."
---
Originally aired during The Horror Game Awards 2026 on Friday 20 November 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
